parent_findings: V9 Ain Chock pilot 2026-08-23, section 14 bis
objective: Stop the environment from presenting a placeholder to the model as if it were electoral information, and separate 'the model failed' from 'the environment could not feed the gate'.

layer_states.PARTIAL_REAL: collected and sourced, honestly incomplete; unknown cells stay unknown
layer_states.PLACEHOLDER: structurally present but carrying no measured content
layer_states.DISCONNECTED: the data exists upstream and is not wired into this pipeline

gate_verdicts.TESTABLE: the environment can feed this gate; the verdict is about the model
gate_verdicts.NOT_TESTABLE_MISSING_DATA: the environment cannot feed this gate; this is not FAIL

regional_policy.rationale: A ballot must never be fabricated to satisfy a schema. The V8 fallback PARTY_PROGRAMME_ONLY_LOCAL_CANDIDATE_STRIPPED produced a second ballot that was the first one amputated, then charged the model with a degeneracy the packet had guaranteed.

scaffold_detection: every axis cell carries only a contentless direction such as VERIFIED_POSITION_AVAILABLE
axis salience orderings are alphabetical rotations shared by several parties
programme_policy.collection_rule: NO SOURCE -> UNKNOWN. Never NO SOURCE -> synthetic rotation.

lineage_rule.statement: A P3 environment may not embed a data layer whose canonical snapshot and certificate are not published together.

canonical_snapshots.LOCAL_CANDIDATES: morocco26/data/candidate_ballot_cells_2026.json (cell level, measured from the embedded named input)

lineage_rule.rationale: The pilot ran on 828 cells / 521 confirmed while the repository still advertised 414 records dated 2026-08-16. 'How many candidates do we have?' must have exactly one answer for the artifact the model sees.

interpretation_boundary: This policy certifies data layers, not realism. A fully REAL set of layers still proves nothing about Moroccan voter behaviour until the paired behavioural tests and historical out-of-sample validation pass.
